File: README.md

Add documentation for S3_ENDPOINT in the 'Running locally' section so that local MinIO setups work correctly instead of falling back to AWS S3.
args.title: Document S3_ENDPOINT in README local setup

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The 'Running locally' section of README.md lacks documentation for S3_ENDPOINT, causing local MinIO uploads to default to AWS S3.
